correctness.rationale: Solving the stationary equations directly gives the full line \((\xi,0,0,-a\xi)\) at \(d=0\) and exactly the two displayed points when \(d\ne0\). Independent substitution verified all four components and reproduced the source-coordinate residual about 0.1796292478 at \((a,b,c,d)=(8,40,15,-0.1)\). The state reflection \((-x,-y,z,-w)\) exactly conjugates \(d\) and \(-d\). For invariant compactly supported measures, the Lie derivatives of \(w\) and \(y^2-z^2\) give \(E[y]=d\) and \(cE[z^2]=bE[y^2]\); equality in the variance bound forces support on \(y=d\), and invariance plus the finite-root quartic argument forces every support trajectory to be an equilibrium.
